`test_meta_ratchets.py::test_prevent_bash_without_strict_mode` now scopes the strict-mode scan to scripts under the mngr checkout root: `find_bash_scripts_without_strict_mode` scans the whole enclosing git repository, which is the outer repo when this checkout is vendored (e.g. as a subtree under `system/vendor/mngr`). In a standalone checkout the added filter is a no-op, so the ratchet's strength there is unchanged.
